phase_3_benchmark.detail: Reproducible, content-addressed benchmark harness (scripts/run_language_migration_benchmark.py) built and run. Component 1 (RFC 8785 canonicalization kernel) MEASURED: median ratio Python/Node 4.24x-4.77x across 3 runs (threshold >3x) -> MIGRATION_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED. Escalation PHASE3-COMPONENT1-CANONICAL-KERNEL-MIGRATION-THRESHOLD-EXCEEDED registered and reserved to the Product Owner (opening a migration decision is authorized by policy; performing the migration is not, since it would substitute approved architecture). Components 2-4 (C3 commit path, C5 event backbone, C4 projection) honestly reported NOT_YET_MEASURABLE: no live PostgreSQL backend (component 2) and no real C4/C5 implementation exists yet (components 3-4), per docs/planning/OCOR_CURRENT_STATE_BASELINE.json. Full detail: reports/development/PHASE3_LANGUAGE_MIGRATION_DECISION.md.
escalations: PHASE3-COMPONENT1-CANONICAL-KERNEL-MIGRATION-THRESHOLD-EXCEEDED (OPEN, reserved to Product Owner, non-blocking for backlog execution)
